title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a set of RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to help developers onboard faster and demonstrate common integration patterns. Motivation: customers ask for canonical examples showing (1) RAG with vector stores + prefix caching, (2) multi-tool agent flows (search, calendar, HTTP API), and (3) docs site quickstarts that can be copy-pasted. This PR contains templates, runnable example code in redwood-examples, and docs site updates with step-by-step quickstarts and screenshots. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates (python + ts) - [x] Add tool-calling quickstart examples (search + http + calendar) - [x] Update docs site quickstart pages and nav - [x] Add tests for example scripts (smoke) - [x] Update README and example metadata - [x] Confirm no breaking API changes Notes: examples are intentionally small, use the Redwood SDKs, and document recommended config (batching, cache TTL, model pins). Linear: ENG-8291. Support ticket: SUP-234. Backwards compatibility: templates default to Redwood-verified models; users can swap model pins without code changes.
